===Gambling===
Twinkbrix likes to gamble, and if you play and win, he will reward you with a {{KeyItem}} [[Shaft Gate Operating Dial]].  This key item is required to enter the level 60 ENM battles [[Pulling the Strings]] and [[Automaton Assault]].  

Twinkbrix will roll a number on his 50-sided dice between 2 and 100. How much gil you trade him will determine how large the number range will be to win.  E.g., if you trade him 2,000 gil, you will win if he rolls between 2 and 10.  If you trade more gil instead, the range will increase above 10.
